slides.title: Tigray: border tension, civilians hurt
slides.body: Monitors told Reuters the Ethiopian and Eritrean armies are within striking distance (Nov. 18). Near Badme, a Nov. 16 drone strike injured at least 4 civilians, BBC Amharic reported.

slides.title: nearly this many displaced in the south
slides.body: By Oromia-Somali clashes around Moyale, Islamic Relief said Nov. 19 (AFP). 50,000+ fled to Kenya.

slides.title: Oromia: ICRC warns of worsening crisis
slides.body: Conflict, attacks on civilians and displacement, the Red Cross said Nov. 19 (Addis Standard).

slides.title: Amhara: fighting near Metema
slides.body: Residents told Wazema of heavy army-Fano clashes on Nov. 16; tolls not independently confirmed.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Choose dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Sources: Reuters, BBC Amharic, AFP/Islamic Relief, Addis Standard/ICRC, Wazema · Nov 17-20, 2026
